input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Compliant; the failed period check is a phrasing false negative. The Deliverable conformity period in 19.2 is written out as "ninety days" rather than "90 days", but it is exactly the 90-day floor in our preferred position and it runs from the later of delivery or acceptance, so it is measured more favourably to us than a pure delivery-date trigger. The software-side warranty is longer still: hosted Services must conform "throughout the subscription term", and under § 8.1 the Agreement runs for three years, so the hosted conformity commitment is expressed in years and exceeds the 12-month software benchmark. Section 19.1 adds an untimed professional and workmanlike services warranty against industry standards, this Agreement and each Order Form, and 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and a no-malicious-code warranty (the "intentionally introduced by Vendor" qualifier is a standard market limitation and does not undercut the position). Section 19.4 gives the required remedy ladder of prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. Section 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and confirms that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. No redline is warranted; if the numeral form matters for internal consistency, the period could be conformed at signature to "ninety (90) days" as a purely clerical change.
